question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to every macOS Talk session, or only sessions activated by Voice Wake?
rationale: The linked issue targets Voice Wake handoff, but the proposed setting is consumed by the shared Talk runtime and therefore also changes manually started Talk sessions when configured.

options.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track the Talk activation source and apply idle auto-deactivation only when Voice Wake started the session, preserving manual Talk as explicitly stopped.

options.title: Apply to all Talk sessions
options.body: Keep the shared-runtime behavior and document that any configured macOS Talk session auto-deactivates after inactivity.

recommendation.title: Limit to Voice Wake sessions
recommendation.body: Track the Talk activation source and apply idle auto-deactivation only when Voice Wake started the session, preserving manual Talk as explicitly stopped.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent shared Talk runtime, config parsing, timeout defaults, and gateway-loader refactors that define the relevant product boundary.
